changelog:
Initial release of scannable-reports — mobile-first text formatting for chat apps.

- Adds Unicode progress bars, sparklines, and emoji status indicators suitable for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
- Supports progress bars, trends, status icons, and monospace tables using only plain text.
- Ensures clear, professional reports that are easy to scan on mobile devices.
- Designed for generating dashboards, metrics, and updates directly in chat apps without images.
summary: Format agent outputs for mobile chat apps. Unicode progress bars, sparklines, and status indicators that render perfectly in Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsA...
